## Description

An analysis of stock performance in the entertainment sector, done with AWS Kinesis, Lambda, S3, Glue, and Python

This is a analysis of the monthly average stock performance of numerous public media companies present on the NASDAQ, with data from AlphaVantage API.

**Direct Link:** https://github.com/TMG-T/Entertainment-Stock-Performance-Analysis-
